events.title: Keeper of the Cards: Robert
events.description: Robert – Intuitive Card Reader (Playing Card Readings) There is nothing complicated about the tools Robert uses—and that’s exactly what makes his work so extraordinary. With nothing more than a traditional deck of playing cards, Robert delivers readings that are clear, direct, and often astonishingly accurate. No elaborate spreads. No mystical theatrics. Just a method passed down through three generations, refined over time into something both simple and profoundly effective. What sets Robert apart is not just what he sees—it’s how he works. He asks no questions. You shuffle the cards. He begins to speak. From the moment the reading starts, information comes through with a natural flow—insight into what’s currently unfolding in your life, what’s shifting beneath the surface, and what is already set into motion. There’s no need to explain your situation or give background. In many ways, that’s part of the experience—watching as he describes details, dynamics, and possibilities with striking clarity, often before you’ve said a single word. Robert’s readings are known for their timing. Again and again, clients find that what he shares aligns with real-life events that unfold over the next 3 days, 3 weeks, and 3 months. It’s not about vague impressions or general advice—it’s about tangible, grounded insight that you can actually recognize as it begins to happen. Some people come in curious. Some come in skeptical. Almost all leave surprised. There’s something deeply compelling about hearing your path reflected back to you in a way that feels both immediate and predictive—where patterns become clear, decisions feel more grounded, and the unknown becomes just a little more understandable. His sessions are focused, efficient, and deeply personal. Whether you’re navigating change, seeking direction, or simply wanting to understand what’s ahead, Robert offers a perspective that is both practical and intuitive—rooted in real-time insight rather than guesswork. Many who sit with him return—not out of habit, but because they’ve seen the accuracy for themselves. This is a reading where you shuffle… and he talks. And what unfolds from there is something you’ll likely be thinking about long after you leave.

As day and night stand in perfect balance, Mabon invites us to honor the harvest, give thanks for what has come to fruition, and gently prepare for the inward turn of the darker half of the year. Through guided meditation, sound healing, chakra work, reflection, ritual, and community connection, we’ll explore the spiritual significance of this sacred threshold — gratitude, balance, release, and the wisdom of nature’s turning wheel. Whether you have walked the Wheel of the Year for many seasons or are discovering these ancient celebrations for the first time, this gathering offers a meaningful opportunity to deepen your connection with the season, honor your own unfolding path, and share in the warmth of a supportive spiritual community. Come celebrate the Autumn Equinox. Honor the harvest. Receive the gratitude, balance, and wisdom that the turning wheel so generously offers.
